metadata.value: FOR US APPLICANTS ONLY: The US compensation range for this full-time position is $[158000]-[197500] + bonus + equity + benefits. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations, and where in the range you may land is determined by job-related skills/experience and location. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process.
